Body.Content:
Users can create and manage their call group directly from Teams on Mobile. They can add or remove members, configure how the group should ring, and choose to forward or simultaneously ring incoming calls to their call group. This makes it easier for users to manage how their calls are handled without needing to switch to the desktop experience.

GA date: December CY2026
